chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 605: The Eight Immortals Attack – Root Carving Demons
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang faces a group of living root-carved Eight Immortals in a flooded ship hold. Underwater ambush, burning wood, self-repairing hull, and a desperate fight for air.
og_title: The Eight Immortals – Root Carving Demons in a Dark Hold
og_description: Li Huowang fights animate root-carved Eight Immortals underwater, using fire, pain-sharing, and tentacles to survive the ambush.
twitter_title: Root Carving Eight Immortals attack Li Huowang underwater!
twitter_description: Li Huowang barely survives a coordinated assault by living root-carved Eight Immortals in a flooded ship.

lore_anchors.definition: A popular Taoist pantheon of eight legendary figures who achieved immortality. Often depicted in art, they are symbols of good fortune and longevity. But in the Dao-Twisted World, any "immortal" likeness is probably a monster.
An art form that uses twisted tree roots to sculpt figures. Alive, they become uncanny: wood that should be still moves and hunts.
A mortal who serves as a Siming's causal link to the world. Finding Doumu’s Heart-Pan is Li Huowang's current mission.
A traditional fire-starting tool: a piece of steel struck against flint to make sparks. Li Huowang uses it to set himself on fire as a weapon.
A weapon made from a spine—likely a remnant of the Ao-Jing Sect's rituals. It can cut rifts to the Great Qi world.
Li Huowang's military-style sword, distinguished by its purple tassels. It is a standard sidearm in the Great Qi world.
A ritual weapon made of bronze coins strung together, used in Daoist exorcism practices. Li Sui wields one.

cultural_notes_faq.a: No, he can’t. He is holding his breath and fighting against the clock. The hallucination at the end gives him a psychological reset, not oxygen.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the “pain sharing” with the rib?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He inserts a rib backward into his own chest; this sends the agony he feels into everything around him, momentarily stunning the enemies. It is a visceral Ao-Jing technique.
